You said:
How should we structure local storage for our offline document passport tool?

ChatGPT said:
We should use Dexie as an IndexedDB wrapper. IndexedDB provides structured, transactional storage in the browser without remote dependencies.

Here is an architectural recommendation:
```typescript
export class PassportDatabase extends Dexie {
  projects!: Table<ProjectRecord, string>;
  passports!: Table<PassportRecord, string>;
  conversations!: Table<ConversationRecord, string>;
}
```

You said:
What about atomic rollbacks when writing both project metadata and passport content?

ChatGPT said:
Dexie transactions support multi-table atomic read-write operations:
```typescript
await db.transaction('rw', [db.projects, db.passports], async () => {
  await db.projects.put(project);
  await db.passports.put(passport);
});
```
If an exception occurs within the transaction callback, all table writes are rolled back automatically.
